{07 0d 00}Everybody oughta help
others in times of need,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

{07 16 00}I said, {ff 00 00 02}7 letters{ff 00 00 00}!

{07 01 00}Hei!{01 00 00 05 00} Tule nüüd, {04 1f 00}!{01 01 00}

messages.en:
{07 00 00}It's kinda weird how being{01 00 00 05 00}

{07 00 00}On kuidagi imelik, et{01 00 00 05 00}

olemine võib tasuda, {07 0b 00}kas

messages.en:
{07 00 00}You...{01 00 00 05 00} I saw that look in
your eyes just then!

{07 0b 00}You thought I'd forgotten
it like a total space
cadet, huh!
{07 06 00}Wait, I WOULD do that!{01 00 00 05 00}
I AM a total space cadet,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Sina...{01 00 00 05 00} Ma nägin just seda

{07 0b 00}Sa arvasid, et ma unustasin
